admission.justification: Spans all start routes: refusing caller mode and permission-bearing feature arguments and selecting the least offered working mode is the entry filter for FAM-N17BB4 — unauthorized choices never reach resolution.

applicability: Every role start route that resolves a working mode.
conditions: No applicable role, user or profile mode exists, so the least offered working mode is selected.
An offered mode value is unknown, so it is refused by name.
exclusions: Caller-supplied mode arguments or permission-bearing feature arguments, which no start route accepts.
statement: No start route accepts a caller mode argument or permission-bearing feature argument. Without an applicable role/user/profile mode, select the explicit least offered working mode and refuse unknown mode offerings by name.
